quality.detail: Each arm reuses its own earlier new5090 sealed binary and base corpus; ON and OFF themselves have different DSO hashes, so this is a real CTA ablation, not identical-binary drift control. There are 56 fresh processes. No evidence designates this run as a replacement of old results or the old nine-cell matrix.
dispersed50 uses (73*i)%256<128; it is not the older strict alternating invalid_z_stride=2 condition. Do not label it as an exact repeat or silently replace the prior alternating row.
No new independent standard KAT or sanitizer qualification. Retained valid CPU oracle reused; malformed row statuses checked by construction. Only final timed output retained.
B8192, 32-byte messages, fixed corpus, 6 process pairs x15 measurements with 5 warmups. Observed min/max paired ratios are not CI; shared timings are not independent input corpora.
Device-resident full-operation interval excludes host setup, allocations/transfers; not end-to-end application time.

Current local tar.gz hash matches the supplied local verification and .sha256 file. Original verifier explicitly says remote checksum was not downloaded; do not claim independent remote-end transport attestation.
No new CPU model/driver/compiler-version query. Build.json identifies reused CUDA compiler path and sm120; toolchain binaries are inherited, not newly compiled.
Historical 4090 comparison can support mechanism-level discussion only; it is not a same-source/input/configuration pure hardware causal test.

findings: 补测包是RTX5090上ML-DSA-65 Verify的CTA分布补充实验，四条件分别为全有效、全无效z、分组50%无效和分散50%无效。
新增56个进程：8个B256资格进程与48个B8192性能进程；保留720条性能计时及8条资格计时，capture 178.267秒。
复用前包同一二进制和固定基础语料，但计时是新run；没有替换旧结果的证据。分散50%采用(73*i)%256<128，不等于旧交替无效条件。
所有585个内部清单路径的字节长度和SHA256验证通过；56个进程原始计时、均值、身份、输入输出SHA和退出状态核对通过；4条件/24配对统计复算一致。
读取16个唯一输入/输出二进制内容，独立确认8种批量/分布组合的输入变异方式和最终逐行接收/拒绝状态；该检查不是重新运行密码学算法或标准KAT。
只有固定输入，计时为设备驻留完整操作范围；只留最终计时输出；没有新的标准KAT或sanitizer，不支持完整安全认证或纯硬件归因。
